whatsappMessage:
Hi Team PANASIA Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has strong 4.2★ reviews with over 600 happy diners near Rajendra Nagar Terminal in Patna, but you lacked a dedicated mobile booking and menu page.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp table reservation, digital multi-cuisine menu, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/panasia

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team PANASIA Restaurant, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp table reservations and a digital menu showcase for your Patna location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept aur design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
